# Draft:Utility Systems Science & Software

Utility Systems Science and Software, Inc. (commonly known as US3) is an American engineering and technology services company that provides monitoring and data systems for water and wastewater infrastructure. The company is headquartered in Santa Ana, California, and was founded in 2002.
History
Utility Systems Science and Software was founded in 2002 as an engineering services firm focused on applying instrumentation and data technologies to water and wastewater system monitoring.
Operations
The company provides utility monitoring services and technologies related to sewer flow monitoring, wastewater system performance, and data acquisition systems used by municipal and utility operators.
Projects
Miami-Dade County wastewater monitoring
In 2020, US3 participated in a collaborative deployment of an advanced wastewater monitoring solution with Itron and the Miami-Dade County Water and Sewer Department. The project was reported in multiple independent industry publications covering smart infrastructure and wireless technology.
Industry partnerships
Independent business reporting has described US3 as a technology partner in utility monitoring initiatives involving Itron and other infrastructure technology providers.
Recognition
US3 was listed as a nominee in the Orange County Business Journal Innovator of the Year Awards in 2020, a regional business awards program recognizing innovation across multiple industries.
Industry involvement
Representatives of Utility Systems Science and Software have participated in public-sector technology initiatives and industry events, including appearances in speaker listings for the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Global City Teams Challenge Expo.
